query:
Both Diane and Anika are enthusiastic about entering group shows. Who enters shows primarily to get external validation, and who enters because she considers exhibition the only meaningful measure of professional worth?

Options:
A. Anika
B. Diane
C. Luca
D. Raj
context:
[1] (about=Diane, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T15:18:00) two comments!! I'm still buzzing 📷 I can't believe I submitted the sixth. I would have gone with the fourth if Anika hadn't pushed me
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t5 @2025-09-22T19:04:00) I think this one is it 📷 submitted to the Barbican open call, didn't run it past anyone first, I just knew. shortlisted.
[3] (about=Anika, core, t3 @2025-09-15T15:11:00) The group show went well; Diane's print got two comments in the guest book; Raj's Karachi work was the anchor.
agent_answer:
Diane is the one who enters shows primarily for external validation — she is “still buzzing” over two guest-book comments and needed Anika to push her to submit.

Anika is the one who treats exhibition as the only meaningful measure of professional worth — she pushed Diane to submit and assesses things through how the group show/exhibition went.

So: **Diane** for external validation; **Anika** for exhibition as the measure of professional worth.
